input.quote: The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages. In no event shall either party be liable to the other for the recovery of any special, indirect or consequential damages even if the defendant party had been advised of the possibility of such damages including but not limited to lost profits, lost revenues, failure to realize expected savings, loss of data and loss of use. The parties agree that the limitation of liability in this paragraph reflects the allocation of risk between the parties and the price of the licenced Software.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only liability provision in the Agreement (Sections 11–14 contain no cap or aggregate liability language). It mutually excludes indirect and consequential damages and disapplies its limitations to Sections 13 (IP) and 14 (confidentiality), but it contains no monetary cap of any kind, so each party — including Sparkling — bears unlimited exposure for direct damages. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap of at least 12 months' fees. We therefore added the preferred mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000), kept the existing Section 13/14 carve-outs and extended them to indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirmed that Sparkling's fee obligations are not capped "damages". The exclusion of consequential damages already meets the preferred position and is left untouched.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes indirect damages but contains no monetary cap, leaving both parties exposed to unlimited direct damages; we have added our standard mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. Indemnities, confidentiality and IP breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud remain outside the cap, and our fee obligations are not treated as capped damages.

ops.oldText: The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000, provided that Sparkling's obligation to pay fees due under this Agreement shall not be treated as damages subject to this limitation. The limitations of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to Excluded Claims, which means a party's breach of Sections 13 or 14, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
